title: Ghost Mode and Haunting

opening_victim.body_location: A legal unoccupied cell in the sealed murder room.
opening_victim.human_playable_victim: The player watches the off-screen opening death, starts as a ghost, cannot report their own body, and has all starting cards returned to their source decks before active play.
opening_victim.bot_playable_victim: The bot starts as a ghost bot under the same limits.
opening_victim.ghost_spawn: same legal map cell as their body inside the murder room
opening_victim.does_not_learn_killer_identity: The opening murder occurs off-screen. The victim knows they were killed but not who killed them unless a later legal clue reveals it.
opening_victim.ghost_start: The victim starts at the body in Ghost Mode and can haunt immediately under normal Haunt Energy rules.
opening_victim.information_limit: The victim does not automatically learn the killer unless an authored cinematic visibly identifies the killer.

movement_and_vision.walls_and_doors: Ghosts pass through walls, closed doors, locks, and creature collision.
movement_and_vision.floors: Vertical transitions occur only through server-defined floor transition volumes to preserve multiplayer coordinates.
movement_and_vision.vision: Ghosts can see every character, body, active monster, armed trap, and haunting anchor, subject to spoiler settings.
movement_and_vision.living_detection: Ghosts are normally unseen and unheard except during a haunt, detection ability, séance, or authored event.

haunt_energy.regeneration_turn_based: 1 at the start of each ghost phase
haunt_energy.anti_spam: Repeated identical haunts on the same target or room receive temporary resistance.

haunting_actions.effect: Set off an already armed built-in or Trap-deck trap when a legal trigger exists.
Draw the top Trap card and place it on a server-approved tile in the current or adjacent connected room.
Raise or lower a monster's interest in a legal room, noise source, scent trail, patrol point, or target category.
Request one legal monster movement toward an adjacent square or connected room during the next monster phase.
Close, bar, rattle, or briefly lock one hauntable door with an available counterplay.
Alter one room's lighting for a short duration.
Move or animate a hauntable prop to create noise, distraction, cover, or a visual cue without fabricating evidence.
Create a directional warning, false trail, intimidation cue, or atmospheric effect.
Reveal a trap outline briefly, distract a monster, or extend a rescue window without revealing private cards.
Temporarily control an authored armor suit, statue, chandelier, bell, mirror, or ritual anchor.

limits: speak in living meeting channels unless a séance opens a temporary bridge
vote, break ties, or count toward quorum
make room theories or final accusations
draw or hold normal Gameplay evidence
loot, equip, trade, or consume living-character Treasure
deal direct weapon or spell damage to living characters
information_safety: Ghost targeting uses opaque server-issued handles. Ghosts do not receive authored trap, lock, passage, loot, monster, role, or solution registries.
server_authority: The authoritative server owns death confirmation, card return, deck shuffling, ghost state, spectral movement, haunt targets, haunt costs, and effect resolution.
source: Attached unified haunting and magic-loot rules v4.2.0
